shortDescription: Creates or removes locations from Nautobot

options.name: api_version
options.description: API Version Nautobot REST API

options.name: asn
options.description: The ASN associated with the location

options.name: comments
options.description: Comments for the location. This can be markdown syntax

options.name: contact_email
options.description: Contact email for location

options.name: contact_name
options.description: Name of contact for location

options.name: contact_phone
options.description: Contact phone number for location

options.name: custom_fields
options.description: Must exist in Nautobot and in key/value format

options.name: description
options.description: Location description

options.name: facility
options.description: Data center provider or facility, ex. Equinix NY7

options.name: id
options.description: Primary Key of the location, used to delete the location. Because of hierarchical nature of locations and name being not unique across locations, it's a user responsibility to query location and pass its id(PK) to the task to delete the location.

options.name: latitude
options.description: Latitude in decimal format

options.name: location_type
options.description: The type of location Required if I(state=present) and does not exist yet

options.name: longitude
options.description: Longitude in decimal format

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the location to be created

options.name: parent_location
options.description: The parent location this location should be tied to

options.name: physical_address
options.description: Physical address of location

options.name: prefixes
options.description: List of prefixes to associate with this location.

options.name: query_params
options.description: This can be used to override the specified values in ALLOWED_QUERY_PARAMS that is defined in plugins/module_utils/utils.py and provides control to users on what may make an object unique in their environment.

options.name: shipping_address
options.description: Shipping address of location

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(present) or C(absent) for adding or removing.

options.name: status
options.description: Status of the location Required if I(state=present) and does not exist yet

options.name: tags
options.description: Any tags that this item may need to be associated with

options.name: tenant
options.description: The tenant the location will be assigned to

options.name: time_zone
options.description: Timezone associated with the location, ex. America/Denver

options.name: token
options.description: The token created within Nautobot to authorize API access Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_TOKEN) environment variable is configured.

options.name: url
options.description: The URL of the Nautobot instance resolvable by the Ansible host (for example: http://nautobot.example.com:8000) Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_URL) environment variable is configured.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_VALIDATE_CERTS) environment variable is configured.

options.name: vlans
options.description: List of VLANs to associate with this location.
